title: erigeron karvinskianus var. mucronatus
intro: Erigeron karvinskianus var. mucronatus, commonly known as Mexican daisy or Santa Maria, is a flowering plant native to Mexico and parts of Central and South America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestive health, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Erigeron karvinskianus var. mucronatus include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. However, more research is needed to fully understand the efficacy and potential side effects of using this plant for medicinal purposes.
